title: Ex4 - Open: Bar chart interpretation
text:
Run the code below in a new cell:

monthList = df['month_number'].tolist()
faceCremSalesData = df['facecream'].tolist()
faceWashSalesData = df['facewash'].tolist()
plt.bar([a-0.25 for a in monthList], faceCremSalesData, width=0.25, label='Face Cream sales data', align='edge')
plt.bar([a+0.25 for a in monthList], faceWashSalesData, width=-0.25, label='Face Wash sales data', align='edge')
plt.legend(loc='upper left')
plt.xticks(monthList)
plt.title('Facewash and facecream sales data')
plt.show()

Look at the grouped bar chart. In which months does facecream outsell facewash? What pattern do you notice overall?
answer: Facecream outsells facewash in most months. Both products show relatively stable sales. The bars are offset using width and alignment to display side by side per month.
